tasks.label: [PARSER] build [lexer debug]
tasks.command: bison -d -o parser/parser.tab.cpp parser/parser.y; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { win_flex -o lexer/lex.yy.cpp lexer/lexer.l }; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { g++ -DLEXER_DEBUG -DPARSER_DEBUG parser/parser.tab.cpp parser/extension/logger/ParserLogger.cpp lexer/lex.yy.cpp lexer/extension/logger/Logger.cpp lexer/extension/buffer/Buffer.cpp lexer/extension/Parser/Parser.cpp -o parser/parser.exe 2>&1 }

tasks.label: [PARSER] build
tasks.command: bison -d -o parser/parser.tab.cpp parser/parser.y; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { win_flex -o lexer/lex.yy.cpp lexer/lexer.l }; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { g++ -DPARSER_DEBUG parser/parser.tab.cpp parser/extension/logger/ParserLogger.cpp lexer/lex.yy.cpp lexer/extension/logger/Logger.cpp lexer/extension/buffer/Buffer.cpp lexer/extension/Parser/Parser.cpp -o parser/parser.exe 2>&1 }

tasks.label: [PARSER] test all
tasks.command: $files = @(Get-ChildItem tests\parser\*.go -Recurse); if ($files.Count -eq 0) { Write-Host 'No parser tests found'; exit 1 }; foreach ($file in $files) { $relative = Resolve-Path -Relative $file.FullName; Write-Host "`n=================================================="; Write-Host "TEST: $relative"; Write-Host "=================================================="; .\parser\parser.exe $file.FullName; Write-Host "Exit code: $LASTEXITCODE" }

tasks.label: [PARSER] select test
tasks.command: $files = @(Get-ChildItem tests\parser\*.go -Recurse); if ($files.Count -eq 0) { Write-Host 'No parser tests found'; exit 1 }; for ($i = 0; $i -lt $files.Count; $i++) { $relative = Resolve-Path -Relative $files[$i].FullName; Write-Host "[$($i + 1)] $relative" }; $choice = [int](Read-Host 'Select test') - 1; if ($choice -lt 0 -or $choice -ge $files.Count) { Write-Host 'Invalid selection'; exit 1 }; $selected = Resolve-Path -Relative $files[$choice].FullName; Write-Host "`n=================================================="; Write-Host "TEST: $selected"; Write-Host "=================================================="; .\parser\parser.exe $files[$choice].FullName; Write-Host "`nExit code: $LASTEXITCODE"
